_about: Mutation-test targets for the passkey broker. Each target names the file to mutate
and the test command that must notice a change (the fast module(s) that cover it).
Run with tools/mutator.py, or as part of tools/run_tests.sh.
min_kill_rate is the floor; below it the run fails, and a target that yields no
mutants at all fails too, so a mutation pass can never be green over nothing.
The vendored harness (tools/*.py) is exempt: its shipped self-tests do not cover the
broker's own surface, and mutating the runner's masker guards can loop forever.

equivalent.reason: FLAG_UP | (FLAG_UV if uv else 0) vs (… else 1): FLAG_UP == 0x01, so the else branch is UP|0 or UP|1, both == UP. No input can distinguish them.

the loop copies into a Uint8Array of exactly bin.length; the extra i == bin.length iteration writes out[i] past the end, which a typed-array integer-indexed write silently ignores. Observable output is identical.

exempt.reason: CLI entry point: argparse wiring and console formatting; exercised end to end by tests/e2e/test_bridge_broker.sh and the integration kind
thin CLI wrapper around bin/bridge_build.py, which is the real target
